record.question: A user wants the same table header repeated at the top of each page when a table spans multiple pages. How to achieve this?
options: Select the header row and enable 'Repeat Header Rows' in Table Properties
Copy and paste the header row manually on each page
Enable 'Lock Table Header' in the View tab
Use a text box instead of a table for header rows
